sql.scope_merge: MERGE INTO main.migration.migration_scope t USING (SELECT 'sales.orders' AS scope, 'SCHEMA' AS scope_kind, 'ann@x.com' AS added_by, TIMESTAMP '2026-10-26 12:00:00' AS added_at, 'app' AS front_door, 'Change,Read' AS sets_granted, 'all_at_once' AS convert_rights, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS removed_at, NULL AS removed_by UNION ALL SELECT 'finance.*' AS scope, 'CATALOG' AS scope_kind, 'ann@x.com' AS added_by, TIMESTAMP '2026-10-26 12:00:00' AS added_at, 'app' AS front_door, 'Change,Read' AS sets_granted, 'all_at_once' AS convert_rights, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS removed_at, NULL AS removed_by) s ON t.scope = s.scope WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.sets_granted = s.sets_granted, t.convert_rights = s.convert_rights, t.removed_at = NULL, t.removed_by = NULL WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (scope, scope_kind, added_by, added_at, front_door, sets_granted, convert_rights, removed_at, removed_by) VALUES (s.scope, s.scope_kind, s.added_by, s.added_at, s.front_door, s.sets_granted, s.convert_rights, s.removed_at, s.removed_by)
sql.stored_scopes: SELECT scope, scope_kind, added_by, added_at, front_door, sets_granted, convert_rights, removed_at, removed_by FROM main.migration.migration_scope WHERE removed_at IS NULL ORDER BY scope
